methodology: Prepare the complete physical 8x8 pair-count table once; verify all 58 W/T/L rows against independent ordered-board replay and the pinned PR130 report. Before any oracle ranking, complete no-rank 4,000-iteration preflight for all four fixed fixtures. Compare three fresh solves to three reweighted prepared solves per fixture with exact serialized-result parity after removing only equity_preparation. Every measured profile receives independent visible-information replay. Warm calls guard all ranking boundaries. A separate tracemalloc call measures reweight, prepared solve and JSON serialization for the 8x8 stack-24 fixture, excluding source-table preparation, oracle and process RSS.
model_limits: Fixed board 2c3c4d, heads-up finite flop betting followed by forced turn/river checkdown, full hidden future-deck W/T/L integration, four fixed weighted range/config fixtures. No later-street betting, preflop solving, rake, multiway play, unrestricted NLHE or general speed claim.
provenance: New benchmark for the independently implemented immutable fixed-flop equity cache. Independent numeric-rule ordered-board replay and own-hand best responses are used for accuracy checks; a pinned previously published report corroborates physical pair counts. No third-party code or runtime dependencies are included.
